name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: House candidate wins primary despite ending campaign, beating Trump endorsee
changes.summary: Thomas Smith won Michigan's 8th District GOP primary on Tuesday — even though he had suspended his campaign in mid-July. Even more surprisingly: He defeated a Trump-endorsed candidate.

changes.title: Dasha Burns presses Mike Johnson on the economy, Iran and Trump's agenda
changes.summary: Dasha Burns presses Mike Johnson on the economy, Iran and Trump's agenda lead image.

changes.title: Trump denies U.S. running low on some munitions, says vast resupplies being made
changes.summary: President Trump is taking issue with recent reports of significant U.S. munitions shortages due to the war with Iran.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Iran says it's close to a deal with Oman over navigation on the Strait of Hormuz, a look at the challenges both candidates for Michigan's U.S. Senate seat will face, Trump touts U.S. economy in Vegas.

changes.title: Pacific islands alarmed by Trump-backed push for deep-sea mining
changes.summary: A Pacific island leader says there were "no consultations" before the U.S. announced swaths of nearby ocean could be auctioned for deep-sea mining exploration, telling AFP the industry faced strong opposition among his people.

changes.title: Tennessee’s Andy Ogles Faces Well-Funded Opposition in House Primary Thursday
changes.summary: Representative Andy Ogles received President Trump’s endorsement, but his challenger, Charlie Hatcher, a former state agriculture commissioner, has the backing of Gov. Bill Lee.

changes.title: Trump’s Gaza Board of Peace issues first building contract – for a military base
changes.summary: Exclusive: Louisiana firm awarded tender to build rudimentary outpost to house Moroccan troops Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, which was set up in January to oversee the reconstruction of Gaza , has finally issued its first construction contract in the devastated territory: a project to build a rudimentary 150-person mi.

changes.title: Trump Said Qatari Jet Was Destined for His Library. That May Change.
changes.summary: A White House official says no final decision has been made about which plane will go on display at the Trump presidential library. That leaves the fate of the Qatari jet unclear.

changes.title: Trump-Backed Michigan Candidate Loses Primary to Rival Who Suspended His Campaign
changes.summary: Without running a single ad or filing a campaign finance report, Tom Smith, who had suspended his bid, soundly defeated Amir Hassan, a Navy veteran backed by President Trump.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: President Donald Trump’s most vocal opponents on the right were sowing the seeds for a future third-party political organization during a weekend get-together aimed at undercutting the Republican establishment. The meeting at Tucker Carlson’s compound in Maine with Rep. Thomas Massie, former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene.
